decisions.statement: A reading is appended rather than written over.
The file is written again only to forget readings.
The last line naming a path is that path's reading.
The file names the agent, so no line does.
A subagent's readings move onto its seat before that subagent's page goes.
A reading this file still holds when its page goes is taken away with that page.
A reading a seat kept comes back here as the page it was made under does.
Lines are kept outside the commit.
No author writes a line here by hand.

definition: the bodies an agent has read, one line for each reading
